scope: Independent NumPy arithmetic directly from every original evaluation/training NPZ and phase JSON. No project/summary/evaluator/auditor imports, no model pickle loading, no training or physics regeneration. Recomputed all published phase scalar metrics, absolute and paired six-seed means/20k bootstrap intervals, qualification and fixed primary/attribution decisions.
method: Float64 sum-based Brier across all actions/horizons and declared subsets; greedy terminal survival from raw probabilities/truth; trapezoidal held-out AUC; fresh-support means; exact six-seed resampling with RNG 27192026 and 20000 draws. Near-zero (<1e-12) contrasts use declared analysis zeroing.
